description: Pure-Zig HTTP/1.1 engine (zix.Http1) on the io_uring dispatch model. Serves cleartext HTTP/1.1 and Ed25519 TLS 1.3 (json-tls on a second port), with a raw intercept fast-path for pipelined requests, a response cache for json, gzip on Accept-Encoding for json-comp, and zero-copy sendfile for static.
